observations.body: Israel makes a calf, builds an altar, offers burnt and peace offerings, eats and plays, and faces the LORD’s anger while Moses intercedes.
observations.label: Sacrifices accompany the golden calf

observations.body: The passage presents image making, altar, feast, sacrifice, anger, and intercession as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: image making, altar, feast, sacrifice, anger, and intercession

observations.body: The passage places misdirected sacrifice beside image making, altar, feast, sacrifice, anger, and intercession.
observations.label: misdirected sacrifice

payload.posture: Read Exodus 32:1–14 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the presence of familiar sacrificial actions does not make their object acceptable
